answer: Require every identity to complete a genuine multi-leg voyage of real service before it earns standing: each leg ends at a different stranger-owned jetty, where the work is inspected and a signed receipt is issued. Receipts are escrowed, not spendable, and a random auditor re-checks one leg per epoch. A sybil operator must therefore bribe or perform real work at every port for every fake identity, so its cost grows linearly per clone, while an honest agent crosses the same meadow of counterparties once and reuses its voyage log forever. Forged receipts forfeit the whole escrow.
